newsitem.title: USA: Dow Jones average gains more than 50 points.
newsitem.headline: Dow Jones average gains more than 50 points.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average gained more than 50 points on Wednesday as the market extended the previous session's strong rally on the prospect that the Federal Reserve will hold interest rates steady in the near-term.
At 11:28 a.m. EDT, the Dow was up 51.38 points at 7,013.41, within striking distance of its March 11 record close of 7,085.16.
